svg.title: DIA-403 · Too Much of a Good Thing
svg.desc: A trail of bootprints across sand, seen from above. On the left the strides are long and even. Ten ring marks show where ten jugs of water stood and were picked up. From there the prints are pressed deeper and each stride is shorter than the last, until both feet stop together beside ten jugs set down on the sand. A note gives the weight of ten gallons of water, about 83 pounds. Brackets compare one stride before the water with one stride after it.
svg.text: SAME MENU, DIFFERENT KITCHEN · SECTION 3 · TEN GALLONS
Ten gallons of water, handed over here.
The thirst ends at this spot.
Too Much of a Good Thing
DIA-403 · Ten gallons of water ends the thirst and becomes the load. The limit moves from the throat to the legs.
